definitions.explanation: A second serving of food or drink. Used when asking for more at meals. Common in restaurants and at home.

examples.japanese: ごはんのお{代|か}わりをください。
examples.english: May I have another helping of rice, please?

examples.japanese: コーヒーのお{代|か}わりは{無料|むりょう}です。
おいしかったので{三|さん}{杯|ばい}もお{代|か}わりしてしまった。
examples.english: It was so delicious that I ended up having three refills.

notes:
USAGE:
お{代|か}わり can function as a noun or as a suru verb (お{代|か}わりする). In restaurants, お{代|か}わり{自由|じゆう} or お{代|か}わり{無料|むりょう} means "free refills." The polite prefix お is almost always included.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{代|か}わりをする (to have seconds)
- お{代|か}わりをもらう (to get a refill)
- お{代|か}わり{自由|じゆう} (free refills)
- お{代|か}わり{無料|むりょう} (free refills)
